description: Free, read-only, needs a key. This key's spendable balance (balanceCents in credits, 1 credit = 1 cent, and as transcription seconds), the per-minute prices, and credit usage over a range (usage: per day and total, split into transcription and server burn; default the last 30 days; from and to in unix ms). response_format concise (default) returns usage totals only; detailed adds the per-day rows. Call it before a paid job or after a 402; top up with create_checkout; individual jobs are in list_jobs.

from.description: Start of the range, unix milliseconds. Default 30 days ago.

response_format.description: concise (default): usage totals only. detailed: also per-day usage rows.

to.description: End of the range, unix milliseconds. Default now.

name: get_account

hasMore.description: true when more items are available (paginated lists).

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page (paginated lists).

result.description: The value, when the tool returns something other than an object.

title: Get balance and usage
